items.title: Scanchannel / CAD hang
items.body:
**Describe the bug** On a Semtech LR2021, `scanChannel()` never returns on an idle channel - it hangs forever. `startChannelScan()` succeeds and the CAD runs, but the blocking wait `while(!this->mod->hal->digitalRead(this->mod->getIrq()))` never sees the IRQ pin assert. Root cause (checked on hardware): the **CadDone interrupt latches in the IRQ status register (~19 ms after the scan starts) but is never asserted on the DIO pin** when the CAD exits back to standby (the `CAD_ONLY` exit mode `scanChannel()` uses). The status register clearly shows CadDone (bit 20), the DIO IRQ mask is correct (`0x00100080` -> DIO5), and DIO5 is configured as IRQ - yet the pin never toggles, not even a 1 us pulse (microsecond-resolution poll). Rx/Tx work only because they attach a hardware edge interrupt to a pin that does assert; CAD's software poll of the pin can never complete. For context, this looks like a residual of #1727 (merged, present in 7.7.1). That PR fixed the CAD *command* path (SetLoraCadParams / SetLoraCad), so CadDone is now generated correctly - but `scanChannel()` still hangs, because its wait loop polls the DIO pin rather than the status register, and CAD completion never reaches the pin. Fix that works: poll the IRQ **status register** in `scanChannel()` (which `getChannelScanResult()` already reads) instead of the DIO pin, bounded by a timeout derived from the CAD duration. `scanChannel()` then returns `RADIOLIB_CHANNEL_FREE` in ~19 ms. Also, unrelated but spotted while here: the CAD exit-mode constants don't match datasheet Table 6-18 - `CAD_RX` should be `0x01` and `CAD_LBT` `0x10`, but RadioLib has `CAD_EXIT_MODE_TX = 0x01` / `CAD_EXIT_MODE_RX = 0x02`; `0x02` returns a command error on the chip. The default `0x00` (CAD_ONLY) path is unaffected. A two-commit fix is ready and hardware-verified if a PR is welcome.
Debug mode output

Not standard RadioLib debug output - this is my instrumented probe reading the raw IRQ status register versus the DIO pin during CAD: ``` [startScan] irqFlags=0x00000180 mapped=0x00100080 dio=5 ; CAD_DONE|CAD_DETECTED correctly mapped to DIO5 ; CAD completes: IRQ status = 0x00100000 (CAD_DONE) at ~19 ms ; DIO pin (GPIO14) tight-polled 60 ms at microsecond resolution: everHigh=0, transitions=0 ; => CadDone latches in the status register but never asserts the DIO pin (CAD_ONLY exit mode) ; after the fix (scanChannel polls the IRQ status register): scanChannel() -> -15 (RADIOLIB_CHANNEL_FREE) in 19ms ; was: hang forever ```

**To Reproduce**
Minimal sketch that hangs

```c++ #include // LR2021 wiring (Meshnology W12 / "WiFi LoRa 32 V5"); adjust pins for your board. // radio DIO5 is wired to the MCU IRQ pin, which matches radio.irqDioNum (default 5). LR2021 radio = new Module(8 /*NSS*/, 14 /*IRQ = radio DIO5*/, 12 /*RST*/, 13 /*BUSY*/); void setup() { Serial.begin(115200); SPI.begin(9 /*SCK*/, 11 /*MISO*/, 10 /*MOSI*/, 8 /*NSS*/); int state = radio.begin(906.875, 250.0, 11, 5, 0x34, 22, 8, 0.0); Serial.printf("begin=%d\n", state); // Hangs forever on an idle channel: CadDone latches in the IRQ status register // but is never asserted on the DIO pin, so the pin-poll never returns. int cad = radio.scanChannel(); Serial.printf("scanChannel=%d\n", cad); // never reached } void loop() {} ```

**Expected behavior** `scanChannel()` returns promptly with `RADIOLIB_CHANNEL_FREE` (or `RADIOLIB_LORA_DETECTED` when activity is present) instead of blocking forever. **Screenshots** N/A. **Additional info (please complete):** - MCU: ESP32-S3 - Link to Arduino core: https://github.com/espressif/arduino-esp32 (via pioarduino platform-espressif32 55.03.39) - Wireless module type: Semtech LR2021 (LR20xx family) - Arduino IDE version: PlatformIO (Arduino framework), not the Arduino IDE - Library version: `master` (git `3c960d0e4`, reports 7.7.1) Diagnosed and written with AI assistance.
